title: [master] Discrepancy in inventory picks when the quantity exceeds the available inventory.
summary: Fixed a calculation error in inventory pick creation that was incorrectly dropping shortage lines when availability exceeded demand with the 'Always Create Pick Line' setting enabled.
key_points: Corrected fallback formula that was subtracting too much, causing blank-bin quantity to become zero or negative
Applied Minimum() function to cap availability at the original remaining quantity to pick
Restores missing shortage lines for un-pickable remainders in production inventory picks
Does not affect normal cases where availability is less than demand
Added test coverage for the production warehouse handling scenario
quote: Cap availability with Minimum(QtyAvailToPickBase, OriginalRemQtyToPickBase), restoring the shortage line without affecting the normal case.
